William Hope Hodgson, The House on the Borderland.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-hope-hodgson/the-house-on-the-borderland

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Hope Hodgson, the author, the annotator, the writer of the introduction, the writer of the foreword, died 1918.

First publication of the text used: The House on the Borderland was published in 1908 by William Hope Hodgson.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1908, before 1931. Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (quoted below). A work published in 1908 enters the United States public domain on 1 January 2004.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last died in 1918), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
